row:
Welcome to the official patient education channel of Advance Chiropractic Clinic Philippines, serving our Cebu and Bacolod communities.

Our videos provide clear, practical guidance to help patients better understand posture, sleeping positions, home care, safe cold-pack use, clinician-recommended exercises, and what to expect during chiropractic care.

These videos are for general patient education only and do not replace an individual assessment, diagnosis, or medical advice. Always follow the instructions provided by your clinician. Stop an exercise or position if it increases pain or causes numbness, weakness, dizziness, or other unusual symptoms, and contact the clinic.

Subscribe for practical spine health, posture, and home-care education from Advance Chiropractic Clinic Philippines.
